rows.note: Use 殺人 as the all-purpose spoken expression for an unlawful killing when the context makes the meaning clear.

example.english: This case is a murder case, and the police are still investigating.
example.traditional: 呢單案係殺人案，警方仲調查緊。
example.jyutping: ni1 daan1 on3 hai6 saat3 jan4 on3 ging2 fong1 zung6 tiu4 caa4 gan2

rows.note: Use 謀殺 when stressing that the killing was deliberately planned or in a legal or news context.

example.english: The defendant was charged with murder, and the case will be heard next month.
example.traditional: 被告被控謀殺，案件下個月開審。
example.jyutping: bei6 gou3 bei6 hung3 mau4 saat3 on3 gin6 haa6 go3 jyut6 hoi1 sam2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken rendering for deliberately killing a person.

example.english: They were arrested by police for suspected premeditated murder.
example.traditional: 佢涉嫌預謀殺人，已經畀警方拘捕。
example.jyutping: keoi5 sip3 jim4 jyu6 mau4 saat3 jan4 ji5 ging1 bei2 ging2 fong1 keoi1 bou6

rows.note: Use it for actually killing something or someone violently, and in an angry threat such as 殺死佢.

example.english: I’m so angry I want to murder him.
example.jyutping: ngo5 nau1 dou3 soeng2 saat3 sei2 keoi5

rows.note: Use this colloquial figurative rendering when saying that one team or person will thrash another.

example.english: We’re going to murder them in tonight’s game.
example.traditional: 今晚場波我哋一定打爆佢哋。
example.jyutping: gam1 maan5 coeng4 bo1 ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 daa2 baau3 keoi5 dei6

rows.note: Use this construction when “murder” means that you strongly fancy eating something right now.

example.english: I really want to murder some char siu right now.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 hou2 soeng2 sik6 caa1 siu1
